channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: Plans were revised after feedback, new evidence matrices were added, and pagination handling was fixed in the SDK. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: Research phases and pattern maps were added, durability checks were introduced, and third‑party resolution was updated. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: Plans and summaries were refined, and a merge fix was applied to improve storage handling. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Diagnostic prints were added to the verification module and later enhanced for better troubleshooting. Repositories: GeniusWallet.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new seven‑phase roadmap was added and backup storage notes were rewritten for clarity. Repositories: GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: The AI component removed the GQHSM submodule and updated documentation about its removal. The blockchain system updated cold‑storage handling and improved backup records. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.
